body: Forward test of the promise-tracker credibility method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.30 (naive base rate 0.40) that: NTPC group adds ≥4.8 GW of renewable capacity (commercial operation) in FY27. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (31-Oct-2026): began FY27 'with an estimation of close to 8 gigawatt'; ~1,300 MW RE added by end-October; 'another 3.5 gigawatt is something which would be able to do'; ~1,615 MW built but 'covered under… the delay in the transmission'. Group installed capacity 91,506 MW at H1; H1 group addition 2,398 MW (NGEL 1,136 MW). Power demand +15% in H1 FY27. Reasoning: The revised target (1.3 + 3.5 = 4.8 GW) has already been cut 40% from 8 GW; PSU RE targets are routinely back-ended and missed, and the transmission bottleneck persists. The cut does reduce the bar, keeping us near 0.3 rather than lower. Resolution: YES if NTPC (group, incl. NGEL and JVs as NTPC reports it) states RE (solar + wind) capacity added/declared commercial in FY27 ≥4,800 MW in its Q4 FY27 results presentation/call or NGEL's Q4 FY27 disclosures (operational RE capacity 31-Mar-2027 minus 31-Mar-2026). Source: NTPC & NGEL Q4 FY27 investor presentations / earnings calls. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: India non-financial, mcap Rs 1,000-20,000 cr at T, 5 yrs from 30-Sep-2016 and 30-Sep-2018 (survivorship-free, dead firms included, stratum-weighted). n=208 company-snapshots (54 distress-census D, 153 live L at weight 5.63, 1 delisted-other X at 4.26); 95% CIs (company bootstrap within stratum): P(>=3x) 14.1-28.7%, P(<=0.5x) 7.0-16.1%, P(blow-up) 10.2-21.4%. Two start dates only, and they disagree (2016: >=3x 16%, blow-up 21%; 2018: 26%, 10%). Price return only (no dividends, ~1%/yr). Blow-up = close <=0.2x the close at T, liquidation or compulsory delisting (no fraud field). Remaining survivorship leak toward FEWER failures (IBBI firms renamed/merged and 221 IBBI rows without identifiers missing; voluntary/merger delistings X under-covered). A survivors-only sample from the same frame says P(<=0.5x) 7% instead of 11%.
